errors.evidence: The x-axis categories are ordered by model size (7B, 13B, 70B), not alphabetically.
The chart contains 12 bars in total, arranged in three groups of four.
The description completely fails to mention that the chart is a grouped bar chart, where bars are grouped by the model types on the x-axis. This is a fundamental structural aspect.
The legend label is “no SFT”, not “no SFT on D0”.

errors.text_span: “+ SFT on D0, D1” represented by a pink bar with a value of approximately 64%, “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” represented by a lavender bar with a value of approximately 73%
errors.evidence: The description swaps the colors and patterns for these two categories. According to the legend, “+ SFT on D0, D1” is lavender and striped, while “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” is solid pink/red.

errors.text_span: and “LLaMA-2-70B” represented by a dark pink bar with a value of approximately 71%.
errors.evidence: “LLaMA-2-70B” is a category group on the x-axis, not a bar category from the legend. The description confuses an axis label with a legend item.

errors.text_span: “no SFT on D0” represented by a light blue bar with a value of approximately 62%, “+ SFT on D0” represented by a yellow bar with a value of approximately 68%, “+ SFT on D0, D1” represented by a pink bar with a value of approximately 64%, “+ SFT on D0, D1, D2” represented by a lavender bar with a value of approximately 73%
errors.evidence: The description assigns a single, incorrect value to each category. Each category corresponds to three different bars with three different values. For example, for “no SFT”, the values are approximately 67%, 70%, and 81%, none of which are 62%.
The description fails to mention the visual patterns on the bars (three are striped/hatched, one is solid color), which is a key way to distinguish the categories.
